scope.note: Island is decided from ZIP, city, and county because VA's county field alone is unreliable.
scope.not_included: Neighbor islands (Hawaii, Maui, Kauai and Kalawao counties) and projects the VA lists as Pending, Rejected, Suspended, Deleted, or any other status. A project missing from this file may still be on the VA's list; check the VA site.

notice: Approvals change. This is a dated copy of the VA list, not the VA's live record. Verify a project's current status with the VA at https://lgy.va.gov/lgyhub/condo-report before relying on it. VA approval status does not guarantee loan approval.
refresh: Re-pulled from the VA API about monthly. last_checked is the date of the most recent pull (Hawaii time).

schema.va_id: VA condo ID (developmentBusinessId), as shown in the VA condo report. Usually 6 digits; a few are alphanumeric (e.g. FHA294).
schema.va_record_id: VA internal record id. Unique per record. Use it to de-duplicate; va_id can repeat.
schema.name: Project name exactly as the VA lists it (uppercase, VA spelling).
schema.address: Project address line from the VA. Empty when the VA has none.
schema.city: City from the VA record, title-cased, island suffix removed. VA spelling kept.
schema.neighborhood: RealityCents neighborhood grouping by ZIP. Not a VA field.
schema.status: VA disposition, verbatim: Accepted Without Conditions or Accepted With Conditions.
schema.review_date: VA review completed date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null when the VA record has none.
schema.request_date: VA approval request received date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null.
